task.description:

- TC-ES-03-01
- TC-EE-08-04

result.summary: Integration tests failed due to BLOCKER infrastructure issue: database connection failures. Pre-checks passed (services healthy), build passed, unit tests passed, but integration tests experienced LOCAL_DISCONNECT errors, PostgreSQL tuple concurrently updated conflicts, and connection termination messages. Target ISS-0113 test cases (TC-ISS-203-*, TC-ES-03-01, TC-EE-08-04, etc.) were not reached before infrastructure failure. Cannot verify fix.

issues.description: Database connection failures during integration test run. PostgreSQL reports: (1) tuple concurrently updated (XX000), (2) terminating connection due to administrator command (57P01), (3) LOCAL_DISCONNECT errors in Zig test runner. Tests hung after 180s timeout with no progress. Affected: TC-TNT-02-05, TC-TNT-03-03, TC-TNT-03-05. Target ISS-0113 tests never reached.
issues.impact: Cannot verify ISS-0113 fix because integration tests did not execute target test cases before infrastructure failure.

result.next_action: ORCH must create ADHOC BACKEND-DEV handoff to investigate and resolve database connection pool/concurrency issues. After infrastructure is stabilized, redispatch TEST-RUNNER to re-run Step 5.
